prioritization.required_data: 5-min OHLC + volume for NIFTY 50 constituent stocks
prioritization.expected_execution_risk: LOW (Index futures/options trade with deep liquidity)
prioritization.reason: Highest information gain; falsifies single-index OHLC limitations directly by providing underlying order-flow breadth.
